name: fetch-swedish-word-compounds
description: A small API server for analysing a given Swedish word by scraping online dictionaries.

scripts.build: npm run check && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.typecheck: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('.cloudflare/types', { recursive: true })" && wrangler types .cloudflare/types/index.d.ts && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
